bio: The Koep family has been synonymous with excellent cuisine since 1995… and you can expect just that when you come to eat here on this property on the 18C Landgut Jaquetrois. This former agricultural estate is planted with beautiful old trees. The restaurant has a cosy dining area (warming fireplace in winter) and a fabulous terrace with views over the Mahnensee – especially charming at sunset! The food is international, regional and seasonal. Tip: Coffee and cake are served on Sundays....
